anomalies.observed: C12, the FAN53610 buck input capacitor connected between BAT+ and GND on the EthernetAndPower sheet, is labelled 2.2mF (millifarads).
anomalies.expected: C12 must be 2.2 µF, the value the spec calls out as the FAN53610 datasheet-recommended CIN and as an exact match to the reference circuit.

evidence.quote: C12 2.2mF (EthernetAndPower sheet, capacitor from BAT+ node to GND next to IC1 FAN53610AUC33X)
C12 (2.2 µF) on BAT+→GND is the input cap

anomalies.impact: A 2.2 mF (≈2200 µF) capacitor is 1000× the intended value and cannot be realised in the intended small ceramic footprint; it would produce a large inrush at plug-in, a very slow BAT+ ramp, and would not match the reference design.

anomalies.observed: C2 on the EPD_Driver sheet, the boost/charge-pump input capacitor on the Display_Power_Switch node, is labelled 10µF/6.3V.
anomalies.expected: The spec's PDI cross-reference states the G1-group-specific capacitor (Meshinger C2) is 1 µF/6.3 V, matching the Pervasive Displays reference circuit.

evidence.quote: C2 10µF/6.3V (EPD_Driver sheet, capacitor from Display_Power_Switch to GND)
C1 (G1 group only): 1 µF/6.3 V | C2 = 1 µF/6.3 V | Matches G1-specific value

anomalies.impact: A 10× larger capacitor on the boost input node changes the EPD boost converter's input filtering/start-up behaviour and deviates from the PDI reference design the board was intended to replicate.

parsed.summary: The drawing deviates from the specified values in the power and EPD sections: the FAN53610 buck input capacitor C12 is drawn as 2.2mF instead of the specified 2.2µF, and the EPD boost-input capacitor C2 is drawn as 10µF instead of the specified 1µF/6.3V. These wrong passive values would change power-up/boost behaviour from the intended reference design.
